footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Excelerate Energy: includes $128M from other items, net; after $128M attributable to noncontrolling interests, $128M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 44.3% to $1.2B in 2025. Gross margin was 56.2%, versus 73.3% a year earlier, and operating income rose 24.0% to $267M, a 21.7% margin.
Net income rose 19.2% to $39.2M, or $1.28 per share. Operating cash flow was $461M and free cash flow $298M, versus $131M; Excelerate Energy returned $8.5M through dividends.
